text: きみ　ひでんマシンも　もってるね　あれで　おぼえた　わざは　ポケモンは　２どと　わすれないよ

structure.jp: きみ　ひでんマシンも　もってるね
structure.en: you have HMs too, I see

structure.jp: あれで　おぼえた　わざは
structure.en: a move learned with one of those

structure.jp: ポケモンは　２どと　わすれないよ

patterns.name: 二度と〜ない
patterns.explanation: ２どと together with a 'not' verb means 'never again'. ２どと わすれない = 'will never forget it'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: あれで　おぼえた　わざ
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing tells you which thing it is. あれで おぼえた わざ = 'a move learned with one of those'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている shows a state that goes on; もってる is the shortened casual form of もっている. もってる = 'you have, you are holding'.
